close_reason: Fixed on worktree-qzr2-wal-trim (f84bcb05). Shale forwards Transaction.commit_version!(tx) to the demux (was: the gap-check PREVIOUS version — demux hw and all derived signals one commit behind). Currency tick removed: one-shot event-driven subscription ({:currency_request, pid, seen_hw}; demux replies now or on next push, after slices). Read-backs 0-3ms regardless of idle; deterministic-chunk invariant repaired (live and replay now agree on versions). Also filed: config-precedence question (app env should override use-config, Ecto-style).
description: Livebook repro: read-back of a just-written key hung ~1-10s (worse with idle gaps: retry backoff resonating with the 1s empty-transaction cadence). Root cause: Shale forwarded the push protocol's gap-check argument (the PREVIOUS commit version) to the Demux, leaving the demux high-water — and every currency signal, cut boundary, and chunk name derived from it — one commit behind reality; reads at read_version=KCV then raced a fresh KCV every retry and could never win. Fix: (1) Shale forwards Transaction.commit_version!(tx); (2) the ShardServer's 100ms currency tick (wall-clock timer) replaced by event-driven one-shot subscription: park -> {:currency_request, pid, seen_hw}; demux replies now if it knows more, else holds interest and notifies on its next push, after slices (ordering guarantees data-before-currency per receiver). Reads now resolve purely from in-flight messages: 0-3ms regardless of idle.
title: Event-driven currency; demux receives the transaction's own commit version
